calculation.description: Measures medium-term trend acceleration relative to the slower 60-day trend, neutralized across the 15-asset universe and volatility scaled. Positive values indicate strengthening relative trends. All inputs use data available through the decision date.

validation.regime_notes: Positive full-sample IC and ICIR clear benchmark gates. Subperiod IC/ICIR: 2020-2023 0.04154/0.11738 (855 dates); 2024-2026 0.02161/0.06210 (1048 dates); 2027-2029 0.03464/0.11994 (782 dates). 2030-2032 had 707 aligned dates but numerical invalid-return artifacts produced no finite ICs and requires revalidation with cleaned prices. Interpret uncertainty conservatively due to 15-asset cross-section.
